title: Map legacy lugs against canonical design for evolution
description: Comprehensive review of ~290 existing lugs against the canonical Wheelwright design, classifying them for the canonical evolution epic. Identifies alignment with canonical principles and flags highest-risk stale lugs that could confuse implementation.

classification_results.keep_for_canonical_evolution: ~40% of architecture lugs align with canonical (Track Chain Protocol, Skills Architecture, Signal Extraction, Hub JIT Context)
classification_results.rewrite_before_execution: ~25% need updates for compatibility (Universal Teach/Learn Protocol, WAI-Manifest.yaml refs, BRIEF.md architecture, CLI commands)
classification_results.post_evolution: ~20% are good ideas requiring foundation (Multi-AI Case Study, Dogfood Skill, Check-Spokes Skill, Sharded Lugs)
classification_results.archive: ~15% are obsolete/superseded (WAI CLI Rebuild, WAI-Guide migration, Python code framework, Standalone teach/learn commands)

highest_risk_stale_lugs.critical_risk: teach/learn semantic references (IDs: 8,9,11,77,86) - could cause implementers to rebuild deprecated patterns
highest_risk_stale_lugs.critical_risk_2: WAI CLI shell commands (ID: 154 signal + various) - references non-existent shell tools
highest_risk_stale_lugs.critical_risk_3: BRIEF.md control plane references - could cause reversion to deprecated state management
highest_risk_stale_lugs.medium_risk: Signal-as-separate-file model, Hub broadcast push model

canonical_principles_checked: PEV as linked lugs not embedded fields
Signals as staged intelligence not inbox commands
recommendations: Update lugs mentioning BRIEF.md, WAI-Manifest.yaml, CLI commands
Hold post-evolution lugs until canonical foundation established
verification_status: Comprehensive backlog review complete with structured classifications and risk assessment
